House.text: Introduction and first reading, referred to Higher Education Finance and Policy

bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to higher education; appropriating money to implement the University of Minnesota's Health Sciences Strategic Plan.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. [+APPROPRIATION; HEALTH SCIENCES STRATEGIC PLAN. +]

[+$5,500,000 in fiscal year 2026 and $2,000,000 in fiscal year 2027 are appropriated from the general fund to the Board of Regents of the University of Minnesota to implement the University of Minnesota's Health Sciences Strategic Plan at the University of Minnesota Rochester and to address the critical health care challenges facing Minnesota. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to higher education; appropriating money to implement the University of Minnesota's Health Sciences Strategic Plan.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. APPROPRIATION; HEALTH SCIENCES STRATEGIC PLAN.

$5,500,000 in fiscal year 2026 and $2,000,000 in fiscal year 2027 are appropriated from the general fund to the Board of Regents of the University of Minnesota to implement the University of Minnesota's Health Sciences Strategic Plan at the University of Minnesota Rochester and to address the critical health care challenges facing Minnesota.
additions: $5,500,000 in fiscal year 2026 and $2,000,000 in fiscal year 2027 are appropriated from the general fund to the Board of Regents of the University of Minnesota to implement the University of Minnesota's Health Sciences Strategic Plan at the University of Minnesota Rochester and to address the critical health care challenges facing Minnesota.
